name: serverguard24
description: ServerGuard24 monitoring: check status, what is down, pause/resume checks, maintenance windows

api_token.title: ServerGuard24 API token
api_token.description: API token from the ServerGuard24 customer area

check_ids.title: Check IDs
check_ids.description: Comma-separated check (service) IDs from the dashboard. The API cannot list checks.

tools.name: sg24_list
tools.description: List contacts, groups, nodes, downtimes, distributors or integrations

tools.name: sg24_get_check
tools.description: Show details and state of one check

tools.name: sg24_problems
tools.description: Configured checks that are not OK

tools.name: sg24_set_check_notifications
tools.description: Turn check alerts on or off

tools.name: sg24_create_downtime
tools.description: Create a maintenance window (cannot be deleted via API)
